assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnoses are I49.5, I48.91, and R55
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy
The payer letter acknowledges that coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The patient's documented recurrent syncope and palpitations directly support the appeal
